description: Read and write a self-hosted Perfex CRM from an AI agent: 148 permission-filtered tools.
name: com.themesic/perfex-crm

headers.description: An API token from your Perfex admin, Setup > API > API Management. The tool list is filtered by this token's permissions, so a read-only token exposes only read tools.
headers.name: authtoken

perfex_host.description: The host of your own Perfex CRM installation, without a scheme or trailing slash - for example crm.yourcompany.com. The REST API module must be installed there with its MCP server enabled under Setup > API > Platform Settings.

title: Perfex CRM
